entries.035af94bb992269b: This business makes and sells magnetic heads and suspensions for hard disk drives (HDDs), as well as magnets. entries.265340b4575de8c4: This business manufactures and sells secondary batteries (rechargeable batteries that can be used repeatedly) and power supplies. The main products are small batteries for smartphones, medium-sized batteries for industrial equipment, and power supplies for industrial equipment. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,370,304 million, accounting for 54.7% of the total for the 4 reportable segments and other, making it the largest business. Segment profit for the same fiscal year was ¥246,682 million. The company explains that small batteries rose on sales effects of new models, medium-sized batteries increased for the industrial equipment market, and power supplies also rose amid a gradual recovery in demand, resulting in higher revenue and profit. The main companies are the company itself, along with Amperex Technology Limited, Navitasys Technology Limited, Xiamen Ampeak Technology Limited, Navitasys India Private Limited, TDK (Malaysia) Sdn. Bhd. and others, totaling 33 companies including the company.
